name: Carving a Path
summary: Da'grosh asks you to challenge the Twilight's Hammer at the Twilight's Shroud. He believes their reliance on devilry and ancient gods leaves them vulnerable.

sections.title: The Shroud
sections.body: Da'grosh points you toward the Twilight's Shroud, a fortress west of his position. He calls its Twilight's Hammer occupants cowards and scorns their reliance on devilry and ancient gods. He wants you to show them how vulnerable they are.

sections.title: A Test of Strength
sections.body: At the Twilight's Shroud, Da'grosh asks you to defeat Twilight Fanatics, Twilight Corrupters, and Twilight Champions. He insists that true strength rests in one's own hands.

faq.q: Who is Da'grosh asking me to fight?
faq.answer: Da'grosh asks you to fight Twilight Fanatics, Twilight Corrupters, and Twilight Champions at the Twilight's Shroud.
Da'grosh describes the Twilight's Shroud as a fortress just west of his position.

faq.q: Why does Da'grosh call the Twilight's Hammer weak?
faq.answer: Da'grosh believes their reliance on devilry and ancient gods makes them weak.

faq.q: What does Da'grosh want me to prove?
faq.answer: Da'grosh wants you to show the Twilight's Hammer that they are vulnerable.

attribution: In-game quest text: Carving a Path
